comparison.objective: Store glasses in a sliding-lid box, put keys in a dish, and close the box.
comparison.physical_skill: Careful object placement, clutter avoidance, and guided lid sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Glasses upright in box, keys in dish, lid shut; no tipping, guide loss, contamination, or disturbance; 1 s hold.
comparison.reason: Discrete storage and lid manipulation do not test granular-flow recovery or screen-based retention.
